properties.name: muster.mode
properties.description: How far a check goes once a rule is violated: fail-fast stops at the first violated rule, collect-all runs every rule and reports every violation.

properties.name: muster.transaction.reorder-advisor
properties.description: Whether to move the transaction advice one step ahead of Muster's, so that rules run inside the transaction, unless @EnableTransactionManagement has an order of its own. Either way, the application does not start if the transaction advice would not run around Muster's.

properties.name: muster.problem-details.mixed-status
properties.description: The status that answers business rule violations of different categories in a Spring MVC application, a client error from 400 to 499. Violations of one category are answered with its status: 403 for forbidden, 404 for not found, 409 for conflict, and 422 for invalid state or no category.

properties.name: muster.rules
properties.description: Switches rules on and off by id, as muster.rules.<rule id>.enabled, for example muster.rules.vehicle.name-unique.enabled=false. Rules are on unless switched off. A key that switches no rule stops the application.

values.description: Stop at the first violated rule.
Run every rule and report every violation.
